title: Dome of the Rock
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Dome of the Rock:gold paneled dome/orb-ring finial,blue mosaic drum and octagonal upper facade,pale marble lower wall,repeated round-arched glazed/blind fields and broad patterned-color parapet bands,sloping lead roof,broad columned south porch/curved canopy and smaller paired-column portals. Five existing shared256² graphs and four browser LODs. Two raw map controls retained;correspondence approximate,heights nominal/fine architecture estimated,unseen north/west entrances and exact terrain joins unverified. Separate Dome of the Chain/compound monuments excluded.

nativeAxes.x: east-northeast toward separate Dome of the Chain

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Earlier Q172077 candidate was reference-only with no exact mapped identity. The current standard PMTiles archive supplies one named Dome of the Rock POI attached to octagonal whole35184376798368 (OSM way/4709536),and a separate named rock/dome part35184663925531. Both lie at the reference location and match the pictured isolated octagon/gold cap. This resolves approximate physical correspondence;the archive does not expose a Wikidata tag,so no new exact-QID OSM match is claimed. Anchor[35.23528665304184,31.778017413436032] is the mapped dome bounding-box center,about4.33m from the earlier reference-only point. Heading0.150746793741rad aligns the mapped south facet:Native+X east-northeast,+Z south-southeast broad porch,−Z north-northwest. No horizontal rescale. Three inspected pictures distinguish the southern portico/eastern side entrance;unseen north/west entrance details remain estimated. Dome of the Chain,Ascension,Prophet,other pavilions,platform/arcades and al_aqsa_mosque Al-Qibli remain separate host content.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Current whole17m and dome part34m are nominal height controls,not survey data. Earlier reference-only facts contain no numeric dimensions.
